author: agent
statement: Discard this Production Plan alternative. It preserves the complete twelve-lot production intent, so it is a valid comparison, but earlier arrival cannot overcome the fixed burn-in horizon and instead lengthens admission/queue exposure. Keep the six-second production-window plan as the selected default and treat simple release compression as bounded negative evidence; a subsequent intervention must change the back-end service boundary or intentionally reshape cadence rather than merely advance every release.
